body:
## Summary

Async prefetch artifacts already declare their SDMA requirement, but kernel-mode initialization did not provision it or check that requirement before registration. Add `pypto.torch.init(enable_sdma=True)` and reject SDMA-requiring artifacts on a context initialized without SDMA before native preparation or registration reuse.

Targets `feat/kernel-mode-integration-test` and depends on [simpler#2583](https://github.com/hw-native-sys/simpler/pull/2583). The runtime submodule and `SIMPLER_KERNEL_REVISION` are synchronized to its head, `0b34c256ff9c027f1afaf83c9c71eadda8ec2daf`.

## Changes

- Keep `enable_sdma` immutable in `KernelConfig`, validate it as a bool, and forward it to `ChipWorker.kernel_init`.
- Read the existing SDMA requirement through `KernelArtifact.requires_sdma`, including restored prebuilt artifacts, and validate it before preparing or reusing a registration.
- Preserve existing prefetch codegen, capture warmup requirements, and native context ownership. No workspace is added to user Tensor arguments.
- Add unit-test cases for configuration immutability, native forwarding, artifact loading, and registration checks; update English and Chinese documentation.
- Retain the explicit keyword-only public API with a documented `PLR0913` exception limited to `init()`.

Simpler provisions SDMA during initialization. Its warmup ELF is optional: a missing `sdma_warmup_path` produces a warning and first-use cold-start latency. After updating the pin, rebuild the Simpler binding/runtime, PyPTO torch_npu adapter, and kernel binaries together.

## Verification

Passed with exit status 0:

```bash
cmake --build build --parallel 2

set -- python/pypto/torch/execution.py python/pypto/_kernel_abi.py \
    python/pypto/runtime/kernel/abi.py python/pypto/runtime/kernel/context.py \
    python/pypto/runtime/_kernel_artifact.py tests/ut/torch/test_init.py \
    tests/ut/runtime/test_kernel_context.py tests/ut/runtime/test_prebuilt_artifact.py
python -m compileall -q "$@"
ruff check "$@"
ruff format --check "$@"
git diff --check
```

Validation is limited to compilation and static checks. Unit tests and onboard tests were **not run**. The optional `_torch_npu` adapter was **not built** because `torch_npu` is unavailable in this environment. PyPTO end-to-end validation for TMR/HBG × eager/ACLGraph remains pending; Simpler's PR results are not claimed as PyPTO integration results.

## CI repairs and verification

- Update the shared non-prefetch artifact mock with `requires_sdma=False`, and match the unsupported framework version without depending on the allowed-version list.
- Fix the feature branch's pre-commit failures: translate source comments, preserve the Unicode test literal through escapes, import `KernelParameter` for type checking, use a real `JITFunction` in the signature test, and assert optional AST results are present before rendering.
- Align ring-size annotations and the `init()` docstring with the already accepted list inputs. Runtime normalization to immutable tuples is unchanged.

The final repair passed Python compilation and the full `python -m pre_commit run --all-files` suite, including English-only, Ruff, Pyright, and documentation checks, on its committed tree before push. No new lint suppressions were added.

GitHub CI on preceding head `c1673068441d89bc0505f81d87ee4c6feb9f79f0` passed unit tests, eager and capture device tests, Docs, and toolchain. Its only failing substantive job was pre-commit, addressed by this repair. Those results are for the preceding head; the latest head requires its own CI results. Local validation remains compilation/static checks only.
title: feat(torch): enable SDMA for kernel-mode async prefetch
